name: canonical
about: The classic 12-piece launch bento: four big corner tiles, paired small tiles, a floating hero in the middle column, one statement tile, one logo tile. Margins 60 x 44, gaps 22.

A.role: big tile, top left: a visual or record

B.role: small: label over a figure (Starts at $799)

C.role: small: icon over a short caption

D.role: tall tile, bottom left: the richest visual or record

T1.role: small: the headline number and its caption

T2.role: small: icon over a short caption

HERO.role: floating hero, no tile: the product or UI itself

E.role: big tile, top right: a visual with overlay text, or a record

F.role: statement tile: a big name or the one call to action (accent)

G.role: tall tile, bottom right: a visual or record
